wct_definition: max simulated request completion in workflow minus workflow arrival; request completion includes arrival, lane queueing, modeled service, replacement delay, KV recovery, and downstream lane queue propagation

failure_model.single_fault_note: Each fault replay is an executed DES WCT replay. Sparse-rate whole-workload estimates use a first-order Poisson mixture of no-fault and one-fault replays; concurrent multi-fault overlap is not modeled in this preliminary campaign.

hardware.topology_assignment: even source ranks use same-node Peer-HBM plus local DRAM; odd source ranks use cross-node Peer-HBM plus remote DRAM; paths retain independent parameters, admission, copy, failure-domain validity, event counts, and recovery counts

normal_path_copy_burden.semantics: For each request, the policy's asynchronous protection copy critical path includes its configured per-tier copy-lane queue and transfer service. A preregistered fraction is charged to the serving lane as front-end/fabric contention; the remainder is overlapped. This is a modeled SGLSim input, not measured A100 overhead.

mechanism_gate.purpose: exercise all four independent-tier residency outcomes without selecting on performance

baseline_fidelity.Native Mooncake: modeled approximation: native-style round-robin route plus asynchronous Mooncake Store DRAM backup and Store restore; complete production Router/Store failover code is not executed
baseline_fidelity.Static FCFS: capacity-matched independent Peer-HBM and DRAM FCFS protection
baseline_fidelity.DejaVu: capacity-matched neighbor Peer-HBM streaming component adaptation
baseline_fidelity.GhostServe: capacity-matched 8+2 parity component adaptation; not a TP=1 end-to-end reproduction

provenance_boundary: All bandwidth, compute, and replacement values are explicit modeled inputs. Results are SGLSim metadata DES preliminary evidence, not physical A100 measurement and not an independent empirical replication.
